 Print Crystal bags are having a moment this festive season You might not be able to fit your phone in these bags, but you’ll definitely turn heads with them. Crystal bags are having a moment this festive season, adding a touch of bling to desi outfits and making their way from Diwali parties to the upcoming wedding season. Whether paired with an embroidered lehenga or a minimal desi ensemble, these mini statement-makers are proving that sometimes, a little bag can make a big style statement. Styling your mini bags They might not fit everything, but they'll make a loud statement. Talking about styling, Bharti Singh, a Delhi-based fashion influencer, says, "I would suggest pairing them with relatively minimal outfits and contrasting fabrics like satin and organza to let the bag stand out." Stylist Isha Bhansali suggests, “Make sure your jewellery doesn’t clash with the bag. Try to avoid adding other accessories to let the bag shine. Since your phone will not be in the bag, dress it up with a blingy cover so it goes with the look.” They might not fit everything, but they'll make a loud statement A bag for every occasion Priyanka Mahajan, founder of a crystal decor brand shares, "Different bags work for different occasions. Jadau bags do particularly well for weddings, sangeet, mehndi — they complement embroidered, jeweled outfits. And our jeweled potli pouches work well for more intimate functions — a sangeet, puja, chooda ceremony — each occasion has a piece that fits it." She adds that Gen Z is leading the trend, "Gen Z is more experimental and less fearful of damaging these bags. They're well-travelled, understand handwork, and take the time to learn proper maintenance." She adds, "An outfit is rarely repeated, but a well-styled clutch can be worn again and again in different ways — held at entry, worn on the wrist while mingling, slung over the shoulder at dinner, or cross-body while dancing."
